li_projects.description: This graduation project, written in Traditional Chinese, examines the significant changes in passenger and cargo flight volumes at Taoyuan Airport due to the COVID-19 pandemic. Utilizing data analysis, economic theory, and forecasting tools, the study identifies key factors influencing these changes and projects future trends.
